resources.string: Mark all installed and pending modules for removal on the next reboot? Keep Magisk root. Each module may clean its own data through its uninstall script. No automatic reboot.

Permanently delete only these two files:
/system/bin/su
/system/xbin/su

Do not delete directories. Preserve the independent Magisk root path. The system mount may temporarily be made writable, then restored. No backup or automatic reboot.
Download both modules from the latest LDMask release, verify and install, then delete temporary ZIPs. Reboot manually when finished.
